mapper.select: SELECT inbox.* FROM ( SELECT 'NOTIFICATION' AS source, n.id AS message_id, CONVERT(n.type USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS type, CONVERT(n.title USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS title, CONVERT(n.body USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS content, n.create_time AS created_at, (r.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_read, r.read_at FROM user_notification n JOIN user_notification_receiver r ON r.notification_id = n.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_flag = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ANNOUNCEMENT' AS source, n.notice_id AS message_id, CONVERT('SYSTEM' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS type, CONVERT(n.notice_title USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS title, CONVERT(n.notice_content USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS content, n.create_time AS created_at, (r.notice_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_read, r.read_time AS read_at FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_read r ON r.notice_id = n.notice_id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.status = '0' AND n.audience IN ('USER', 'ALL') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_type IN ('01', '02', '03')) ) inbox WHERE inbox.type = #{type} ORDER BY inbox.created_at DESC, inbox.source DESC, inbox.message_id DESC
